title: Setting out on a journey
cue: What the Prophet ﷺ said once mounted for a journey
arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ
transliteration: Subhaana lladhee sakhkhara lanaa hadhaa wamaa kunnaa lahu muqrineen, wa'innaa ilaa rabbinaa lamunqaliboon, allaahumma innaa nas'aluka fee safarinaa hadhal-birra wat-taqwaa, waminal-'amali maa tardaa, allaahumma hawwin 'alaynaa safaranaa hadhaa watwi 'annaa bu'dah, allaahumma antas-saahibu fis-safar, wal-khaleefatu fil-ahl, allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika min wa'thaa'is-safar, waka'aabatil-manzar, wasoo'il-munqalabi fil-maali wal-ahl
translation: Glory be to the One who has made this subservient to us, when we could not have managed it ourselves; and to our Lord we are returning. O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and mindfulness of You, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and fold up its distance for us. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the One who looks after the family. O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the hardship of travel, from a distressing sight, and from an evil return to wealth and family.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih Muslim, ed. Muhammad Fu’ad Abd al-Baqi, hadith 1342: https://shamela.ws/book/1727/3201

provenance.note: The Shamela copy of the printed text runs واطو عنا together as one word; hadith-api writes them apart, as we do.

when: Once mounted for a journey, after saying Allahu akbar three times
usage.evidence: Ibn Umar taught that when the Prophet ﷺ settled on his camel to set out on a journey he said Allahu akbar three times, then this (Muslim 1342). Its opening words are from the Quran, 43:13-14.
